cards.name: spray7
cards.summary: CorelDRAW Artistic Media Sprayer list (category Splash_Splatter). Shipped preview (the .cdr file's own embedded thumbnail, not a script render) shows one solid black ink splat: a round central blob with two long tapered streaks flying out (to the left and the upper right), a small spur at its upper left and a separate teardrop drop just below it, like a drop that hit the page hard. Sprayed along a path, these objects repeat with the spacing, size and rotation set on the property bar.
use_for: grunge, street or band posters
ink-splash accent behind a headline or logo
messy splatter trail along a path for skate, graffiti or sports graphics
avoid: Clean corporate or minimal layouts: it reads as messy ink.
Long or dense paths: object count and redraw time climb fast; raise Spacing or lower Dabs on the property bar.
Editing one sprayed object, recolouring it, or sending to apps that need plain vectors: Object > Break Artistic Media Apart and ungroup first.
cards.applies_to: open path or curve: copies of the spraylist objects are placed along the path (draw with the Artistic Media tool in Sprayer mode, or apply to a selected curve); the result is an Artistic Media group that follows the path when it is reshaped
cards.how_to_apply: Artistic Media tool (I) > Sprayer on the property bar > Category 'Splash_Splatter' > Sprayer list 'spray7'; pick it before dragging, or select an existing curve and pick it to spray along it (Effects > Artistic Media docker lists it too). Tune object size, Dabs / Spacing, Spray order and Rotation on the property bar. Script: the harvest records no call that applies a sprayer; the spraylist artwork is in C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Draw\CustomMediaStrokes\Splash_Splatter\spray7.cdr. Scripted substitute: import that file and place copies along the path with SubPath.GetPointAt / SubPath.GetTangentAt + Shape.Duplicate (static copies with no live link to the path; not tested by the harvest).

verified.note: Solid black splat: round blob with long tapered streaks to the left and upper right, a small spur at its upper left and a separate teardrop drop below it (not a third attached streak).

review.changes: summary: the downward element is a separate teardrop below the blob, not a third attached streak; spur placed at the upper left

cards.name: Default
cards.summary: Preset of CorelDRAW's bitmap Bevel effect (BevelFactoryEffect, listed live by BevelFactoryEffectDS.PresetItems). From the name only: the Bevel effect's own default settings (the list's starting entry; the defaults themselves were not recorded). No thumbnail shows it: all 16 Bevel preset renders came out pixel-identical, so the look is unverified.
use_for: a quick raised edge on a bitmap cut-out, as a starting point to tune
buttons and badges
avoid: Look unverified: the render failed (all 16 Bevel presets gave identical pixels, the preset key never reached the effect), so this card is built from the name only; preview it before committing.

Opaque full-frame photos: the PGD render harness treats Bevel as an edge effect that works on the bitmap's transparent edge, so expect little or no change on a plain photo; use a cut-out bitmap with a transparent background.
Vector objects that must stay editable: use Effects > Bevel (the vector Bevel docker, Soft Edge / Emboss) instead; for real depth use Extrude.
cards.applies_to: bitmap (harvest: requires bitmap); treated by the PGD render harness as an edge effect, so give it a bitmap with a transparent background (e.g. a shape or text converted with Object > Convert to Bitmap, transparent background on), which is how the harness builds its edge-effect target (not confirmed for this preset)
cards.how_to_apply: Pick 'Default' in the preset list of the Bevel bitmap effect (data source BevelFactoryEffectDS.PresetItems, preset guid 7cc7e96a-0171-4281-bc7f-b8c2bf4fab87). The harvest labels the list Effects/Bevel/Preset, but no Effects-menu item in the effect harvest uses BevelFactoryEffectDS; Effects > Bevel opens the vector Bevel docker (an object-model effect), and whether this list appears there was not established. Script: not proven. Shape.Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect("PGD", "BevelFactoryEffect Preset=7cc7e96a-0171-4281-bc7f-b8c2bf4fab87") ran and changed pixels, but every Bevel preset gave the same pixels, so the Preset key is ignored; set the bevel in the UI.

verified.note: No thumbnail: all 16 Bevel preset renders were pixel-identical and the gallery audit dropped them; checked the text instead against the batch (guid, requires bitmap), the live list (Default is its first entry) and cdr_effect.json (Effects/Bevel is the vector docker, no item uses BevelFactoryEffectDS); it is name-only, as it says.

review.changes: applies_to: 'Bitmaps > Convert to Bitmap' corrected to 'Object > Convert to Bitmap', the harvested menu path (cdr_menu.json Object/Convert to Bitmap)
